answer: Make every key earn its seat with work nobody else can do for it. Each epoch a VRF hands each key 300 unique scans of old harbor tide ledgers to transcribe; 15 are hidden gold rows with known text, and the key is paid only at 92% gold accuracy. That is about 40 min of inference, ~$1.50 per key per epoch, so 50 aliases cost 50x, and cheap models spiral below the bar. A 10% overlap with other keys' items catches farms: identical misreadings of the same lagoon soundings merge those keys into one seat.
